name: Mapper 227 address-latch multicart
connections: Cpu.Write & Cpu.RomSelectBar=0 & Cpu.M2.falling -> mapper.AddressLatch[0..10] from Cpu.Address[0..10]
notes: Mapper-227 physical intent: address-latch multicart hardware with up to 1 MiB PRG ROM, two 16 KiB CPU windows configurable into NROM-128/NROM-256/UNROM-like arrangements, 8 KiB unbanked CHR RAM, mapper-controlled H/V CIRAM wiring, multicart NROM-mode CHR write protection, optional four-bit solder-pad PRG low-address mux and no IRQ. The CPU write data bus does not select banks; the completed write address does.
